messages:
Ivy: quick heads-up— onboarding GeminiLite (hf -> redwood) for int8 eval. Seeing a weird tail bias on glossary tokens (dates, acronyms) after quant. fp16 baseline fine.
Marcus: did you check qkv layout and rotary prefs? last time a headwise rotary scale caused token-specific drift in punctuation/abbrs.
Ivy: converter output shows `q_proj/k_proj/v_proj` split, but original HF had fused `qkv.weight`. I sliced contiguous chunks; per-head cosine drops around heads 6-10.
Tao: that screams interleaved fused layout. Also check tokenizer normalization: HF doc mentions NFKC; our convert pipeline sometimes skips it for speed. tiny id mismaps amplify under int8.
Ivy: ran quick re-order (interleave) -> ppl on glossary set fell from 14.0 -> 12.7 (closer to fp16 12.5). So ordering was majority cause.
Marcus: nice. remaining gap might be rotary freq/scale. run a phase drift test: feed long repeated token sequence and plot phase per head. if headwise scaling differs, you'll see divergence.
Tao: also run a vocab-shadow sweep across 200k tokens to catch ligature/quote ids. add an onboarding lint that fails convert if >0.01% id diffs.
Ivy: opened draft PR to add `--detect-qkv-order` to converter (tries both split modes and picks best by median per-head cosine), and `manifest.qkv_order` metadata.
Marcus: on runtime side we should tag KV cache with `layout` and add a permute shim on load so warm-starts across layouts don't silently degrade.
ops-bot: CI run started: eng-ml/gemini-lite-convert (matrix: qkv-detect, rotary-scan, vocab-sweep) -> https://ci.redwood/internal/14101
Ivy: CI artifacts show detect picked `interleaved`. rotary-scan suggests headwise amplitude variance but within our warning threshold. vocab-sweep flagged 0.015% diffs concentrated on narrow no-break space + smart-quotes.
Tao: increase normalizer to force NFKC in convert pipeline for HF-derived models. add tokenizer parity check to CI.
Marcus: action items: Ivy -> PR for detect + manifest + docs. Tao -> normalizer shim + token-id parity test. Marcus -> runtime KV layout tag + permute shim + warm-start microbench.
Ivy: leaving note in onboarding doc: "If you see token-specific PPL spikes after conversion, try `--detect-qkv-order` and run vocab parity check before canary." :thumbsup:
